pr_body:
##### Summary
Fixes #11568 

Considering internal discussions we had and the reported bug, the following changes are made with this PR :

-  Changing the order that plugin was reading parameters before to run.
-  Remove short options, considering that number of threads are becoming bigger than Latin alphabet

##### Component Name
ebpf.plugin
##### Test Plan

1 - Compile this Branch without start Netdata.
2 - Go to `/usr/libexec/netdata/plugins.d` to run plugin on terminal. When you run, always redirect `stdout` and `stderr` to files.
3 - After each test, verify `CHART` lines, because they will indicate charts that were enabled.

##### Additional Information
This PR is missing documentation changes, because we will have a PR exclusively for this.

It is expected that this PR will always keep the most restrictive options.

This PR was tested with the following arguments:

| Option | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| without options | All charts are visible |
| -all, --all  | All charts are visible |
| -help, --help | Prints help on screen  |
| -version, -- version | Prints Netdata version  |
| -global, --global |  Only shows global charts without `apps` and `cgroups` |
| -process, --process | Only show global process charts  |
| -process -all, --process --all | Only show process charts (global and apps)  |
pr_comments: Merging so I can do mdflush on top of this.

issue_context.title: Long/short options don't work for eBPF plugin binary
issue_context.body:
##### Bug report summary

Long (and I believe short) options provided to the eBPF plugin are not properly applied; all other programs still get run even if only specific ones are selected.

##### Component Name

ebpf.plugin

##### Steps To Reproduce

1. Compile everything.
2. Try to run the `ebpf.plugin` binary with any long/short command and notice that all other programs still run.

##### Expected behavior

Only the selected program should run.
comments: @thiagoftsm it would be very nice to get this issue fixed, using debug mode for a specific module is quite handy for troubleshooting (e.g. https://github.com/netdata/netdata/pull/11662) 🙏
@ilyam8 it is on my horizon, I plan to fix this and the DEB packages before new release.

review_comments: Thank you for getting rid of the short options :smile:
Just a note that it seems the process stuff always gets started and remains activated no matter what.
Yes, you are right. We will always start the thread, but we won't have the charts.

@thiagoftsm I saw that the process thread continues writing BEGIN/SET/END though. Here's an example run:

https://gist.github.com/UmanShahzad/c9b56abd0e8f9c961aaa7c3ea6cafb09
It doesn't define the charts though indeed, but shouldn't we also suppress the dimensions-sending part?
@UmanShahzad with last commit the reported problem is fixed, thanks!
